core_obligations: Identify the completion of B with its completion along the ideal generated by the maximal ideal of A and observe that the induced map on completions is finite (proof lines 10772-10776).
Use flatness of A to B to obtain flatness of the completed map by the chapter's lemma on flatness after completion (proof lines 10776-10780).
Conclude that the completed map is free by finiteness and flatness over a local ring (proof lines 10780-10782).
Compute the rank as one from the agreement of the residue fields and conclude that the map is an isomorphism (proof lines 10782-10788).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the completed map and note finiteness (proof lines 10772-10776).
Transport flatness to the completion (proof lines 10776-10780).
Get freeness from finite flat local (proof lines 10780-10782).
Rank one from equal residue fields (proof lines 10782-10788).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a flat local map of Noetherian local rings which is unramified, in the sense that the maximal ideal extends to the maximal ideal and the residue fields agree, induces an isomorphism on completions, and the proof is a 17-line argument in four steps. It first identifies the target completion as the completion of the source ideal and uses that the induced map is finite; then it converts flatness of the original map into flatness of the completed map by a lemma of the chapter; next it concludes that the completed map is free by finiteness and flatness over a local ring; and finally it computes the rank as one from the hypothesis on the residue fields. The finite flat local input and the rank computation are the two decisive steps, and both are displayed.
